summary: Synthesis library, build script, six engine levels, cabin ambience, silent running and cabin_ir are built. All nine sounds pass every rule in the build output (cabin_ir without the CLAP rule, see deviations). Tests are green (15). Full build went into assets/audio/render and its manifest validates against the contract.
built: tools/audio/build.py with --only --category --out --no-clap --describe --manifest-only, manifest assembly from per-sound JSON, contract validation, selection.json downloads (schema guessed)

sounds.recipe: Two beating machine tones (47 and 71 Hz series) through the shared hull modes with a trace of shared plasma noise.
sounds.seen: Energy only below about 170 Hz in steady lines, -38.0 LUFS, loop seam ratio 0.5, swing 5.5 dB.
sounds.doubt: Describing model called it a fan motor; may sound too thin and tonal for an engine idle.

sounds.recipe: Same tones and noise seeds, more flow noise through more hull modes, slight roughness.
sounds.seen: Same lines as idle plus broadband 30-200 Hz fill, -32.0 LUFS.
sounds.doubt: Fan motor according to the describing model.

sounds.recipe: Same hull and seeds, flow noise now dominant, tones about 7 percent higher, moderate roughness.
sounds.seen: Hull modes at 71, 118 and 163 Hz stand out, fill up to 400 Hz, -27.0 LUFS.
sounds.doubt: Described as a motorboat idling; the intended spaceship character is a judgement for the owner's ear.

sounds.recipe: Stronger flow, deeper flutter and saturation, pitch up about 11 percent.
sounds.seen: Wider 100-500 Hz energy, no rattles yet, -23.0 LUFS.
sounds.doubt: Described as a car engine idling; the neg list of the category contains a car engine.

sounds.recipe: Full roughness and saturation, pitch up 15 percent, a few rattles (activity 0.43 of the pool) at 1 to 4 kHz.
sounds.seen: Dense rumble below 400 Hz, rattle spots at 1-4 kHz about 35 dB down, high share 0.0, -20.0 LUFS.
sounds.doubt: Describing model called it ambient synth music.

sounds.recipe: Beyond full thrust: maximum roughness, three more percent pitch, all rattles of the pool.
sounds.seen: Same body as full thrust, about 12 rattles over 8 s between 1 and 3.5 kHz, true peak -3.5 dBFS, -17.0 LUFS.
sounds.doubt: Rattles may be too regular and too many for a deliberate now-and-then; describing model heard a repeated melody.

sounds.recipe: Stereo fan air noise, blade-pass partials, faint motor whine and 100 Hz transformer hum, five thermal ticks, all through the cabin impulse response circularly.
sounds.seen: Quiet band 80-1300 Hz with a boxy swell near 250 Hz, nothing above 2 kHz but faint tick dots, -45.0 LUFS, swing 4.0 dB.
sounds.doubt: Ticks are only about 6 dB above the high-frequency floor and nearly invisible in the picture: they may be inaudible. Describing model said car engine idling.

sounds.recipe: 100 Hz transformer hum with odd harmonics and a faint pink floor, four thermal ticks, through the cabin.
sounds.seen: Hum lines at 100 and 300 Hz over a very low floor, -55.0 LUFS, ticks about 12 dB above the high-frequency floor.
sounds.doubt: Rule swing limit was raised to 12 dB for this loop (measured 2.3 dB, so it was not needed); describing model said engine idling.

sounds.recipe: Image-source reflections of a 2.2 x 1.6 x 1.4 m box (first at 3.6 ms), dense decorrelated tail of 0.3 s with a resonance near 250 Hz, direct impulse at sample 0.
sounds.seen: Stereo, waveform decays within about 0.15 s, spectrogram energy concentrated at 200-400 Hz and gone by 0.3 s, ear correlation 0.15.
sounds.doubt: CLAP margin is -0.038 (an impulse response is not a sound to compare); not counted as a failure.

verified: Ran the unittest suite: 15 tests OK (determinism, no seam, level targets, ceiling for all registered sounds, registry refusals, cabin IR shape, helper smoke tests)
Built all nine sounds into assets/audio/render with CLAP and the describing model; build output says pass for all nine with the CLAP margins listed in the manifest
Rebuilt two sounds in a second process and compared sha256 of the WAV files: identical
manifest.json of assets/audio/render validates against the contract (the build's own validator; it also lists the other agents' sounds that were in the folder, 59 in all, no placeholder flag)
Looked at the spectrogram PNGs of all nine sounds (the silent running and ambience pictures after the final tick change)
Band-energy table of the six engine files: low bands vary smoothly with thrust, rattles first appear at full thrust
notVerified: Nothing was listened to; every judgement is from measurements and pictures
Crossfading of the six engine files was checked only through band shares and pitch peaks, not by an actual crossfade render
The Whisper rule for radio is not implemented (radio category)
selection.json handling follows a guessed schema; it was not run against a real file
The loop level swing limit of 6 dB is my own reading of the design rule, not a number from SOUND_DESIGN.md
Helpers hull_blow, thump, rattles in non-periodic mode and transformer_tone are only smoke-tested; their sound has not been judged
deviations: cabin_ir: CLAP margin is recorded but not counted as a failure; an impulse response is a convolver input
cabin_ir is listed with dry false so the page does not convolve it with itself
cabin_ir level is -3 dBFS peak in the file (not specified in the brief)
silent_running_loop is registered with swing_max 12 dB
The describing model's answers (fan motor, motorboat, car engine, ambient music) do not name a spaceship engine; recorded in the manifest and not treated as failures per SOUND_DESIGN.md
Categories with no stand-in or other builds are not in the manifest; the missing ids are written to missing.json next to it instead of into the manifest
openIssues: The engine character is tonal at idle and may need ear judgement; the describing model hears fan or motorboat
Cabin ticks are quiet; raise the factor in cat_cabin.py (5.0 and 6.0) if they cannot be heard
CATEGORY_DEFAULTS and the LEVELS entries not named in the brief (shield hits, breaker, touchdown names) are provisional until their category owners confirm them
forNextAgent: Write tools/audio/synth/cat_<category>.py (the build imports every cat_*.py automatically; a broken one only reports an import error). Inside: `from . import register, ...` then `@register("<id from sounds.json>") def f(ctx): return float_array` with exactly ctx.n samples, shape (n,) or (n,2) when sounds.json has channels 2; ctx.spec is the sounds.json entry, ctx.params its params, ctx.rng(salt) a generator fixed by the id; use seeded("family/name") for noise a family shares. Never normalise: add the id to LEVELS in synth/levels.py (loops LUFS, one-shots true peak) or it falls back to provisional CATEGORY_DEFAULTS. Loops: use periodic_noise, freq_filter, through_hull(periodic=True), snap_freq/sine/machine_tone, periodic_lfo/slow_wander so they close; pointwise nonlinearities keep periodicity. Structure sounds: excitation -> through_hull -> structure_lowpass, rattles only when strong; a one-shot must start within 5 ms and end in silence (fade_edges). Cabin sounds: apply_cabin(dry)[:, 0] for mono. Build: .venv-audio/Scripts/python.exe tools/audio/build.py --only id --no-clap, then open <out>/<category>/<id>.png; drop --no-clap for the CLAP margin and add --describe for the Qwen answer (slow, loads once). Pitfalls: a --no-clap rebuild overwrites the earlier CLAP result in that sound's JSON; rules are in synth/rules.py and the cabin switch rules (centroid 800-5000 Hz, not longer than listed) apply to switches one-shots of 0.5 s or less; hull rings 2 s at 37 Hz so short files must fade their end; tests: .venv-audio/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest discover -s tools/audio/synth/tests. The register() decorator raises on an unknown or duplicate id, so importing two files that register the same id fails.
